attack: The USD-down / CAD-up bloc (catalyst-junkie, perma-bull, value-guy) smuggles a Canada-rates-higher view into CAD-up versus the dollar. FACT: Dec implied gap is still ~162bp (SOFR 4.1975 versus CORRA 2.58) after a delivered Fed hike, hot US gauges (labor 75 / inflation 72 / consumer 74 / activity 69) versus Canada (labor 38 / inflation 55 / consumer 45 / activity 66), and CA-US 2Y still -140bp after -15bp in 5d. INFERENCE: unless the US path rolls over, CAD-up versus USD requires Canada to out-hike a still-rising SOFR strip that those seats do not show. Paying COAZ26 or CA 2Y is a Canada-only rates bet, not a USD-down trade.

Energy is the only CAD-up-versus-USD residual they have, and the packet already weakens it. FACT: WTI 107.02 at the 96.4th percentile with +24.2% 1m log; USDCAD still +1.74% 1m / +1.10% 5d; USDCAD-WTI r-squared 0.017; Saudi Oman workaround reduced the extreme oil-supply tail. INFERENCE: CAD failed to capture the oil spike versus USD, so buying CAD versus USD on ToT is fading a residual the market already refused. UNKNOWN: whether later Canadian energy CPI still overwhelms core-near-2%.

Cross-merchant and positioning-cynic CAD_UP is CAD versus AUD, not CAD versus USD. FACT: AUDCAD 99.8th 1y is the product of USDCAD +1.74% 1m and AUDUSD +0.20% 1m. Short AUDCAD is long the CAD leg that just cheapened after the Fed event, plus an AUD housing/RBA mix (AONIA already +21.5bp by Oct / +51bp by Mar-2027, NSW stamp duty -24% y/y). INFERENCE: that is unnecessary second-order risk when USDCAD isolates the first-order USD policy premium with SOFR 3.85 versus CORRA 2.29 carry.

EURUSD 10.9th 1y, USDCHF 99.8th 1y and NZDUSD 12.9th 1y already show USD strength; USDCAD at 74th 1y after a 3m USD-versus-CAD dip of -1.25% is the lagging USD pair, not a completed CAD collapse. INFERENCE: the CAD-resilience assumption still in the 3m residue is what long USDCAD fades. A 99th-percentile AUD cross or a 4th-percentile CA-US 2Y fade does not own that transmission.
defense: FACT: long USDCAD remains the cleanest USD-spot expression of a still-rising SOFR path (overnight 3.85, Dec 4.1975, Aug-2028 4.6025) versus lagging CORRA (2.29 / Dec 2.58), a 156bp cash carry, and a hotter US labor/inflation/consumer mix versus Canada core-near-2% and employment -42k. Spot at ECB 1.401047 on 2026-09-18 is only 74th 1y / 87th 5y while CA-US 2Y is a 4th-percentile 5y gap — incomplete FX transmission, not a blow-off.

INFERENCE: CAD-up versus USD needs either a SOFR rollover or a BoC energy-pass-through that closes the overnight gap from the Canada side. Neither is in the live paths. The 5d USDCAD log z 1.61 is the start of transmission after the 3m USD-versus-CAD dip, not a reason to reverse into short USDCAD or into a CAD-long cross. Carry from SOFR over CORRA supports holding the USD pair through the 4-8 week horizon; short AUDCAD pays the opposite carry.

UNKNOWN: signed CFTC nets (PACKET_FACTS CAD/AUD nets null; CME 403), executable broker marks (entry/target/stop remain null), and whether future Canadian energy CPI overwhelms labor 38. Those unknowns were already in the original principal risks and do not convert a Canada-rates catch-up into USD-down.

Concession, not a level: withdraw or reverse if the US SOFR path stops being a rising year-end path from 3.85 overnight / Dec implied 4.1975, or if MX CORRA Dec 2.58 is replaced by a much larger energy-pass-through reprice that closes the 156bp overnight gap without further Canada labor/core deterioration, or if an unconstrained oil-supply tail reverses the Saudi workaround. WTI remaining high is not by itself concession because the packet USDCAD-WTI link is weak. Until one of those packet facts changes, long USDCAD stands versus the USD-down / CAD-up cases.
holes_in_opposing_case: FACT: SOFR 3.85 versus CORRA 2.29 is 156bp overnight and Dec implied 4.1975 versus 2.58 is still about 162bp. catalyst-junkie, perma-bull and value-guy tag USD_DOWN / CAD_UP from a Canada-rates-higher story without showing that US-Canada policy gap is compressing. INFERENCE: a BoC catch-up that only tracks a still-rising SOFR path is not a USD-down / CAD-up case versus the dollar. UNKNOWN: post-Dec CORRA (only four MX contracts).

catalyst-junkie rejects long USDCAD as 'gap persistence, not repricing' while paying COAZ26. FACT: CA-US 2Y analogs after the same ~-17bp 1m cheapening stayed extreme over 1m (2025-01-30 -5bp; 2024-12-18 -3bp; 2022-11-15 -4bp; 2024-05-02 -9bp). INFERENCE: persistence of the 156bp cash gap is the FX object; paying Dec CORRA can print while SOFR also rises (rate-hawk / trend-follower US_RATES_UP), which supports USD versus CAD rather than CAD-up. Their own invalidation already names core-near-2% and labor 38 as the hold case that would keep CAD cheap versus USD.

perma-bull's own independent check states pessimism is in the Canada policy path and in CAD's failure to rally, with USDCAD +1.74% 1m alongside WTI 107.02 (96.4th percentile) and packet USDCAD-WTI r-squared 0.017 (weak). INFERENCE: that is an admission the energy/ToT CAD-up versus USD did not print. Short USDCAD as their spot alternative therefore fights the tape they just described. Activity 66 does not cancel labor 38 / employment -42k / wages +2.0% y/y as the BoC offset.

value-guy maps long CA-US 2Y (receive US 2Y 4.76 / pay CA 2Y 3.27) into USD_DOWN / CAD_UP. FACT: carry-is-king uses the same structure and correctly tags USD_UP / CAD_DOWN. INFERENCE: harvesting US-over-Canada carry is not a CAD-up-versus-USD expression. PACKET_FACTS CAD TFF nets are all null; the claimed CAD leveraged short of 39022 contracts and covering is not in the common facts, so their flow confirmation of CAD-up is unsupported. Their closest analog (2025-01-30, -145bp) still cheapened 5bp over 1m, inside this seat's 4-8 week horizon.

cross-merchant's own path_to_current_price says the last month of AUDCAD strength is mostly CAD weakening in USD space after the 16 Sep Fed hike (USDCAD +1.74% 1m versus AUDUSD +0.20% 1m). INFERENCE: short AUDCAD therefore buys the CAD leg that just cheapened versus a still-rising USD policy premium. It adds AUD housing/RBA second-order risk the USD pair does not need, and it is negative carry (AONIA 4.35 versus CORRA 2.29). A 99.8th-percentile cross is a discovery screen, not proof CAD should rally versus USD.

positioning-cynic CAD_UP is versus Australia, not versus USD. FACT: CFTC TFF nets are null; CAD OI 358186 is 81.7th percentile 1y, not a signed long-CAD crowding fade versus the dollar. Unsigned 99th AUD OI cannot justify buying CAD against USD. Their preferred CA-AU 2Y RV leaves the 156bp SOFR-CORRA gap unexpressed.

rate-hawk's AUD_UP tag does not defeat long USDCAD: their own spot_candidate is long USDCAD on the same Fed/SOFR versus lagging CORRA comparison. AUD-higher in AU rates is not an AUDUSD-up case and is not a USD-down case.

rate-dove and mean-reverter leave usd_view neutral / CAD not_relevant. Short AUDUSD or AUDCAD is not a USD-down rebuttal. INFERENCE: a defensible USD pair exists (USDCAD, both policy paths available); treating USD as irrelevant adds AU housing second-order risk instead of owning the US-Canada gap. Broad USD is still only 11.9th percentile (stale), so the incomplete USD expression is USDCAD, not an AUD cross.

carry-is-king, perma-bear and trend-follower share USD_UP / CAD_DOWN. Their rates-over-spot preference treats USDCAD versus CA-US 2Y r-squared 0.022 as if that kills FX. INFERENCE: that weak link is the discrepancy — CA-US 2Y at the 3.8th 1y / 4.3rd 5y percentile has not transmitted into USDCAD at only the 74th 1y / 87th 5y ECB fix. Fading a 5y rates extreme is a different object from owning incomplete spot transmission with positive carry.
